method: UiTransportBaselineFacts.CaptureUiTransportBaseline on the shared in-process FlutterHost (backend only, no network hop). One view whose root column holds a title and 10 button and 10 text UiChildRefs. 5 warm-up runs, then 50 timed runs per scenario, Stopwatch around the shell's HTTP calls. first-paint: GET view + one sequential GET /apps/node per reference. click-round-trip: POST /apps/event for a button + GET of that button (nudge latency excluded). root-view-poll-2s: one GET of the view; perMinute = 30 polls. Bytes are UTF-8 response bodies (click digits excluded). Times compare only against reruns of this fact on the same machine: Debug build, 32 logical cores, Microsoft Windows 10.0.26300, .NET 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105.
